messages:
emma_sales: Heads up — we have an EU enterprise prospect asking for a crisp data residency + data flow sketch and full subprocessor disclosure for their vendor risk team. They also flagged the SIG/CAIQ questionnaire. POC needs to start next week; legal wants artifacts by Friday. Can someone pull the canonical diagram and subprocessor list (EU hosting, no cross-border replication) so I can attach to the RFP? cc @raj_security @lisa_solutions

lisa_solutions: I can draft a simplified diagram. Need answers on whether customer requires customer-managed KMS and whether logs/metrics go to our hosted analytics or into customer-owned storage. Any specifics? :thinking_face:

raj_security: They asked for "no replication outside EU" and "customer-controlled keys" in the email. Also asked about data-at-rest/encryption details and where metadata like request IDs are stored. We should be explicit about: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit, KMS options (Redwood-managed or customer KMS in their AWS account).

mike_infra: For hosted mode we have an EU region stack (eu-central-1). Typical flow: app -> redwood api (eu) -> inference pool (dedicated GPU in eu) -> optional object store (S3 eu) for logs + KV cache in regional redis. By default we do not replicate to other regions unless customer opts into DR. I'll paste a tiny ascii sketch: 

```
User App (EU) -> Redwood API (eu-central)
                           -> Inference Hosts (dedicated GPUs, eu-central)
                           -> KV cache / prefix cache (redis, eu-central)
                           -> Logs / Usage Events -> S3 (eu-central) or customer-owned S3
KMS: option A = Redwood KMS (eu); option B = customer KMS (cross-account CMK)
No cross-region replication unless explicitly enabled in SOW.
```

ana_legal: Please also include a subprocessor list + last-reviewed date. We need to know if any vendors process data outside EU (monitoring, observability, backups). If backups live in eu-central it's fine, but some vendors (error reporting) have US endpoints by default.

lisa_solutions: Understood. @mike_infra can you export the current subprocessor CSV and annotate which ones have EU-only endpoints? I can then build a one-page diagram + bullet list for legal and the customer's vendor-risk team.

mike_infra: Exporting now — giving the current list. Quick summary lines (not the full CSV): 
- Cloud provider: AWS (eu-central-1 primary) : eu-only for hosting unless DR enabled
- Monitoring: Datadog (EU processing contract; EU processing mode available)
- Error reporting: Sentry (has EU cluster option; default was US for older customers)
- Metrics pipeline: Internal Redward-metrics (EU) + optional third-party (we can turn off)
- KMS: AWS KMS (we support customer CMKs)
- Logging pipeline: S3 (eu) or push to customer bucket (preferred for sensitive customers)

raj_security: Add note: audit logs (authz/authn) are retained in eu for this deployment; we can provide export to customer S3 for SOC/forensics. Also include our SOC2 + ISO27001 attachments link.

emma_sales: This is great. Can someone drop links to the artefacts? Need: 1) 1-page data flow PNG, 2) subprocessor list CSV, 3) short bullet answers for SIG control items they asked about (KMS, retention, logging, access control). Preferably by EOD Wednesday so I can send to customer on Thursday. :pray:

lisa_solutions: Draft diagram uploaded to internal figma: https://intranet.redwood/diagrams/eu-dataflow-2026 (view-only). I'll export PNG and attach once mike confirms subprocessor flags.

mike_infra: Subprocessor CSV exported: https://internal.redwood/ops/subprocessors/2026-03-19-eu.csv  — flagged Sentry as "needs EU cluster" and Datadog as "EU processing possible; contract amendment exists". Also attached KMS instructions snippet for customer CMK setup: 

```
1) Create CMK in customer AWS account (eu-central-1)
2) Add key policy with Redwood service principal
3) Share key ARN with sales -> we request kms:Encrypt kms:Decrypt limited to inference role
```

ana_legal: Perfect. Emma, include a short note in the RFP: "Redwood offers hosted EU-only deployments with optional customer-managed KMS and no default cross-border replication. Subprocessors and control artifacts provided." I'll sign off if diagram + CSV + SIG answers are attached.

emma_sales: Thanks all. I'll assemble and send out draft to customer tomorrow morning. If anyone sees anything missing ping me here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: Exported artefacts attached to thread storage (link valid 7d): https://files.redwood/export/1917654321/attachments.zip

mike_infra: Quick follow-up — for POC we should confirm whether they want logs routed to customer bucket (recommended). If yes, we'll need the bucket ARN and IAM role by SOW sign-off.

emma_sales: Noted. I'll ask them in the POC kick-off email. Closing loop here unless new asks come up. :white_check_mark:
